## Teaching Experience

<br>

##### **Teaching Assistant, University of East Anglia**

*March 2024 – present*

I have teaching experience at both undergraduate and postgraduate level, including teaching *Applied Methods for Impact Evaluation* (PG) and *Economics and Statistics for Economists* (UG), as well as contributing to assessment and marking for *Environmental Economics* (UG) and *Behavioural Finance* (UG).

<br>

##### **Tutor, The Brilliant Club**

*September 2023 – May 2026*

[The Brilliant Club](https://thebrilliantclub.org/) is a university-access charity that works with schools and PhD researchers to provide young people with university-style learning and support their progression to higher education. I delivered both pre-designed and independently developed courses through teaching placements at local secondary schools.

My course, **“What’s the Business of the Business?”**, introduced students to questions around how businesses operate, the role of firms in society, and the economic and social consequences of business decisions.
